title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Brazil, Remote)


Highlights

  • $80k–$100k USD per year (depending on experience)
  • Full-time remote position based in Brazil
  • Must have excellent spoken and written English
  • High ownership role across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems


About

AREENA is the all-in-one operating system for sports leagues. From scheduling and payments to real-time AI-generated highlights, we help organizers run smoother seasons while delighting players with pro-level digital experiences.


Our platform spans league operations, mobile apps, payments, streaming, AI-generated content, internal operational tooling, and emerging AI automation systems.


Our stack is primarily Python, Flutter, MongoDB, GraphQL, and AWS. We are a fast-moving startup with a flat structure, rapid iteration cycles, and a strong product/engineering culture focused on shipping.


Why This Role Matters

This is not a narrow feature-development role.


You will become one of the primary engineers responsible for understanding and evolving a large, interconnected production platform used by real sports organizations and thousands of players.


You’ll work across:

  • backend systems,
  • frontend/mobile applications,
  • infrastructure,
  • AI-assisted development workflows,
  • internal operational tooling,
  • streaming/video systems,
  • and emerging AI agent frameworks.


You’ll work closely with AREENA leadership and our fractional CTO to take ownership of major parts of the platform while helping shape the future technical direction of the company.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex product and systems problems, learning quickly, and operating with a very high degree of autonomy.


What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

  • Build and maintain production features across backend, frontend, and mobile systems
  • Work heavily with AI coding agents and internal AI development workflows to accelerate engineering output
  • Quickly learn and navigate a large existing codebase spanning multiple domains
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and long-term technical direction
  • Improve platform reliability, scalability, developer tooling, and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate directly with product leadership to rapidly prototype and ship new ideas
  • Help build next-generation sports technology experiences including:
  • streaming workflows,
  • AI stat tracking,
  • automated highlights/content generation,
  • and internal AI operational agents


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong full stack capabilities across modern frontend and backend systems
  • Strong Python experience
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • Experience working with APIs, databases, and production-scale applications
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Comfortable owning large areas of a codebase independently
  • Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills
  • Able to move quickly while maintaining good engineering judgment
  • Highly proficient using AI coding tools/agents as part of daily development workflows
  • Startup mindset: proactive, resourceful, adaptable, and product-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Flutter or mobile app experience
  • GraphQL experience
  • MongoDB experience
  • Experience with AI/LLM tooling
  • Experience with video, streaming, or real-time systems
  • Interest in sports or sports technology
  • Previous startup experience


What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • Fully remote role within Brazil
  • High ownership and direct impact on product direction
  • Small, highly collaborative team
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and sports technology products
  • Fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility


Hiring Process (2–3 Weeks)

  • Intro conversation (30 min)
  • Background, communication, and startup fit
  • Technical deep dive (60–90 min)
  • Architecture discussion
  • Real-world debugging/system design conversation
  • Discussion of prior projects and ownership
  • Practical exercise
  • Small scoped engineering task focused on real-world product development and AI-assisted workflows
  • Final conversation
  • Meet leadership and discuss long-term fit
  • Offer & references


Application Instructions

Please include:

  • A resume or LinkedIn profile
  • Links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, or products you’ve worked on
  • A short written overview of:
  • systems/products you personally owned end-to-end,
  • your experience operating across both frontend and backend systems,
  • and how you currently use AI coding tools or agents in your engineering workflow

title: AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world software engineering workflows.

In this role, you will create tasks grounded in real open-source code changes such as bug fixes, migrations, and refactors. These tasks are used to evaluate how effectively AI agents can understand large codebases, apply precise modifications, and produce correct, testable outputs.

You will work within a structured evaluation framework (Harbor), define clear task instructions, design verification logic, and decompose complex engineering problems across multiple specialized agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world open-source code changes (bug fixes, migrations, refactors)
  • Work with the Harbor evaluation framework to run and validate tasks inside Docker environments
  • Write clear, precise task instructions specifying file paths, function signatures, expected behavior, and constraints
  • Design and implement Python-based verification scripts to validate correctness of agent-generated code changes
  • Create decomposition strategies that split complex code changes across multiple independent sub-agents
  • Run, debug, and refine tasks within containerized environments to ensure reproducibility and determinism
  • Evaluate task performance signals and improve task quality, clarity, and difficulty


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Python and JavaScript development
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Strong experience reading and navigating large open-source codebases (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Git workflows , including pull requests, diffs, cherry-picking, and working with specific commits
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging container issues)
  • Experience writing test scripts (pytest, unittest, or custom assertion-based testing)
  • Ability to write clear, precise, and unambiguous technical specifications


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading foundation model companies
  • Collaborate on high-impact work at the frontier of LLM evaluation and reasoning
  • Remote, flexible opportunities with global teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week).



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live

  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early

What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Brazil, Remote)


Highlights

  • $80k–$100k USD per year (depending on experience)
  • Full-time remote position based in Brazil
  • Must have excellent spoken and written English
  • High ownership role across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems


About

AREENA is the all-in-one operating system for sports leagues. From scheduling and payments to real-time AI-generated highlights, we help organizers run smoother seasons while delighting players with pro-level digital experiences.


Our platform spans league operations, mobile apps, payments, streaming, AI-generated content, internal operational tooling, and emerging AI automation systems.


Our stack is primarily Python, Flutter, MongoDB, GraphQL, and AWS. We are a fast-moving startup with a flat structure, rapid iteration cycles, and a strong product/engineering culture focused on shipping.


Why This Role Matters

This is not a narrow feature-development role.


You will become one of the primary engineers responsible for understanding and evolving a large, interconnected production platform used by real sports organizations and thousands of players.


You’ll work across:

  • backend systems,
  • frontend/mobile applications,
  • infrastructure,
  • AI-assisted development workflows,
  • internal operational tooling,
  • streaming/video systems,
  • and emerging AI agent frameworks.


You’ll work closely with AREENA leadership and our fractional CTO to take ownership of major parts of the platform while helping shape the future technical direction of the company.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex product and systems problems, learning quickly, and operating with a very high degree of autonomy.


What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

  • Build and maintain production features across backend, frontend, and mobile systems
  • Work heavily with AI coding agents and internal AI development workflows to accelerate engineering output
  • Quickly learn and navigate a large existing codebase spanning multiple domains
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and long-term technical direction
  • Improve platform reliability, scalability, developer tooling, and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate directly with product leadership to rapidly prototype and ship new ideas
  • Help build next-generation sports technology experiences including:
  • streaming workflows,
  • AI stat tracking,
  • automated highlights/content generation,
  • and internal AI operational agents


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong full stack capabilities across modern frontend and backend systems
  • Strong Python experience
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • Experience working with APIs, databases, and production-scale applications
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Comfortable owning large areas of a codebase independently
  • Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills
  • Able to move quickly while maintaining good engineering judgment
  • Highly proficient using AI coding tools/agents as part of daily development workflows
  • Startup mindset: proactive, resourceful, adaptable, and product-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Flutter or mobile app experience
  • GraphQL experience
  • MongoDB experience
  • Experience with AI/LLM tooling
  • Experience with video, streaming, or real-time systems
  • Interest in sports or sports technology
  • Previous startup experience


What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • Fully remote role within Brazil
  • High ownership and direct impact on product direction
  • Small, highly collaborative team
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and sports technology products
  • Fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility


Hiring Process (2–3 Weeks)

  • Intro conversation (30 min)
  • Background, communication, and startup fit
  • Technical deep dive (60–90 min)
  • Architecture discussion
  • Real-world debugging/system design conversation
  • Discussion of prior projects and ownership
  • Practical exercise
  • Small scoped engineering task focused on real-world product development and AI-assisted workflows
  • Final conversation
  • Meet leadership and discuss long-term fit
  • Offer & references


Application Instructions

Please include:

  • A resume or LinkedIn profile
  • Links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, or products you’ve worked on
  • A short written overview of:
  • systems/products you personally owned end-to-end,
  • your experience operating across both frontend and backend systems,
  • and how you currently use AI coding tools or agents in your engineering workflow

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Atuar na interlocução técnica com instituições públicas, representantes setoriais e demais stakeholders

  • Garantir consistência técnica e metodológica em relatórios, notas técnicas, apresentações e posicionamentos institucionais
  • Representar o Instituto E+ em eventos, grupos de trabalho e projetos nacionais e internacionais na temática

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Agronômica, Agronomia, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências Ambientais, Ciências Florestais ou áreas correlatas


Conhecimento sólido das seguintes metodologias e referenciais:

  • IPCC
  • ISO 14040 e ISO 14044 (Avaliação de Ciclo de Vida)
  • GHG Protocol
  • Metodologias setoriais como WorldSteel, IAI e Bonsucro


Conhecimento de mercado de carbono e instrumentos regulatórios e comerciais, tais como:

  • Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões (SBCE)
  • CBAM (União Europeia)
  • EU ETS
  • EU RED
  • RenovaBio
  • Entendimento da regulação de carbono no mercado doméstico e internacional


Capacidade analítica e de síntese

Excelente redação técnica

Inglês avançado

  • Boa comunicação oral e segurança para representação institucional
  • Perfil colaborativo e flexível para atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location :


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: desenvolvedor sênior
description:

olá, dev sênior | Node.js & React!


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada de comércio B2B que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar. uma empresa jovem com um sonho grande: transformar o atacado da moda brasileira.


a teceo tem uma plataforma com muito sendo construído: catálogo, pedido, integrações com ERPs, políticas comerciais, sell-out, webhooks, gateway de pagamento. o volume de produto é alto e a complexidade técnica também. aqui dev precisa entender o negócio!


esse cargo é pra quem tem maturidade pra tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia, questionar arquitetura quando faz sentido, e traduzir um desafio de negócio em solução sem precisar de muita mão na mão. você vai trabalhar num time fullstack com um fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA, onde ferramentas como claude code, open code e agentes de code review fazem parte do dia a dia, e esperamos que você saiba tirar proveito disso.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se desafiar e sair da zona de conforto, ajudando a construir uma plataforma que está mudando como o atacado da moda funciona no Brasil.


o que você vai fazer

  • projetar e desenvolver novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade
  • criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, funcionais e de integração)
  • discutir arquitetura, tecnologias e caminhos técnicos com o time
  • traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas simples e eficientes
  • contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • participar das cerimônias ágeis
  • apoiar o time de suporte em dúvidas técnicas quando necessário


fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA

na teceo, IA não é palavra da moda — é ferramenta de trabalho:

  • geração de documentações de negócio e especificações técnicas com IA
  • uso de claude code, open code e outras ferramentas no processo de codificação
  • code review e refinamento via agentes (ex: coderabbit)
  • correção de bugs com apoio de agentes


o que procuramos em você

  • sólido conhecimento em React e Node.js, com experiência em NestJS
  • experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e arquitetura REST
  • vivência com microsserviços e integrações entre sistemas
  • experiência com testes automatizados
  • desejável: CI/CD e configuração de Docker
  • boa comunicação verbal e escrita — você vai precisar se posicionar tecnicamente
  • ao menos 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento fullstack


o que oferecemos

  • remuneração de R$ 9,5k a R$ 16k
  • contratação PJ
  • programa de partnership
  • bonificação semestral
  • cartão Swile e TotalPass
  • home-office
  • horários flexíveis
  • bootcamp teceo — imersão presencial anual com o time
  • fio-da-meada — rumos e números do negócio numa reunião trimestral
  • eventos: happy hours, learning days, torneios e por aí vai


nenhum bom negócio é feito sozinho. quer entrar pro time? fale com a gente!

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior para integrar o time de uma empresa de que presta serviço de BPO Financeiro, consultoria e serviços de CFO Service nos EUA, atuando como peça-chave na gestão financeira estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de diferentes portes, segmentos e níveis de maturidade.

Este profissional será responsável por conduzir, de forma autônoma e estruturada, processos de planejamento, orçamento, análise de desempenho e geração de insights financeiros para múltiplas empresas simultaneamente, atuando como referência técnica e parceiro estratégico dos sócios e gestores dos clientes atendidos.


Planejamento e Orçamento

  • Conduzir o processo de orçamento anual (budget) , revisões orçamentárias (forecast) e planejamento de longo prazo das empresas da carteira.
  • Estruturar e manter modelos financeiros de DRE gerencial, fluxo de caixa projetado, balanço patrimonial e análise de cenários (base, otimista, conservador).

Apoiar a definição de metas, KPIs financeiros e operacionais alinhados às estratégias de cada cliente


Análise de Desempenho e Reporting

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais mensais (Management Reports) com análise de variação realizado vs. orçado, drivers de resultado e recomendações de melhoria.
  • Construir e manter dashboards financeiros e painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos clientes.

Realizar análises ad-hoc de rentabilidade por produto, cliente, canal, unidade de negócio ou centro de custo.


Gestão Financeira Multiempresa

  • Atuar como business partner de múltiplos clientes simultaneamente, organizando agenda, prazos, entregas e priorizações de forma independente.
  • Conduzir reuniões de resultado com sócios, diretores e gestores das empresas atendidas, traduzindo números em recomendações claras e acionáveis.

Identificar gargalos, riscos financeiros e oportunidades de melhoria nas operações dos clientes.


Processos, Controle e Melhoria Contínua

  • Padronizar e otimizar processos de planejamento financeiro dentro da carteira atendida, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar a estruturação de plano de contas gerencial , centros de custo e rateios que reflitam corretamente a operação de cada cliente.

Garantir a integridade, consistência e qualidade das informações financeiras geradas, atuando próximo às áreas de contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber e tesouraria.


Qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em Planejamento Financeiro, FP&A, Controladoria ou Consultoria Financeira.
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou certificações em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A, CFA, CGMA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prática com construção de orçamento, forecast, DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa projetado .
  • Domínio avançado de Excel (modelagem financeira, fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query).
  • Vivência em gestão simultânea de múltiplas empresas, clientes ou unidades de negócio — experiência em BPO Financeiro, consultoria, family office, holding ou auditoria é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma autônoma , gerenciando o próprio tempo, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto.
  • Inglês nível avançado/ fluente (usará inglês no dia a dia).


Perfil Compartimental (o que esperamos de você)

  • Autonomia e protagonismo: capacidade de conduzir o trabalho de ponta a ponta com mínima supervisão, propondo soluções em vez de apenas reportar problemas.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade de interpretar números, questionar premissas, identificar inconsistências e enxergar a história por trás dos dados.
  • Resolução de problemas: postura proativa para destravar entregas, lidar com ambiguidade e propor caminhos práticos diante de cenários complexos.
  • Organização e disciplina: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, prazos e clientes simultaneamente sem perder qualidade ou prazo.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: habilidade de traduzir análises técnicas em mensagens compreensíveis para sócios e gestores de diferentes níveis.
  • Postura consultiva: atuação como parceiro estratégico do cliente, e não apenas como executor de relatórios.

Maturidade profissional e ética: discrição no trato com informações sensíveis e confidenciais.


Diferenciais

Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a backend software engineer
  • Strong hands‑on experience with C# and .NET (8+) in enterprise environments
  • Solid database experience with Oracle, or strong experience with SQL Server plus willingness to transition and deepen Oracle skills
  • Experience building and supporting applications in Microsoft Azure (azure function apps, APIM, service bus, event grid, key vault, authentication mechanisms, and cosmos db)
  • Background working within Agile methodologies and scrum teams
  • Ability to support both new feature development and production issues
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, ability to work independently in a distributed team, and great communication skills


Plusses:

  • Experience in the insurance domain, particularly policy or claims systems
  • Prior work supporting or modernizing legacy .NET applications while contributing to cloud‑based development
  • Exposure to Azure‑based modernization or cloud migration initiatives


Day to day:

Insight Global is looking for a Sr. Backend Engineer to join our large insurance client. In this role, the engineer will work as part of an Agile team supporting backend services for the client's policy and claims system, contributing across both legacy and modern platforms. Approximately 75% of the role will focus on new feature development, with an increasing emphasis on Azure‑based solutions, while 25% will involve production support for existing .NET and Oracle‑based applications. The engineer will participate in daily stand‑ups, work within two‑week sprint cycles, and deliver into monthly production releases. Day to day, this individual will design, develop, and enhance backend functionality using C# and .NET, collaborate with team members to implement scalable solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and help evolve the platform toward more cloud‑native architectures. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, has great communication skills, and can work independently.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Java Sênior - Inglês Avançado - Home Office em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESENVOLVEDOR BACK-END JAVA SENIOR (COM INGLÊS AVANÇADO)

Sobre o desafio

Fará parte de um time de tecnologia altamente colaborativo, atuando em projetos estratégicos que envolvem soluções digitais, integrações complexas e construção de plataformas escaláveis na nuvem.

O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de aplicações backend robustas, seguras e performáticas, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, com forte atuação em cloud (GCP) e ambientes distribuídos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.
  • Aplicar princípios de arquitetura moderna, com foco em Arquitetura Hexagonal e desacoplamento entre camadas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, POs e demais desenvolvedores na definição de soluções técnicas aderentes ao negócio.
  • Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo alta cobertura e confiabilidade do código.
  • Atuar na evolução contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab, garantindo entregas frequentes e seguras.
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e revisões de código, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do time.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações em ambiente cloud (GCP).


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com desenvolvimento backend em Java.
  • Domínio do ecossistema Spring: Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Spring Cloud.
  • Experiência com Hibernate e ferramentas de build como Maven.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes com JUnit e Mockito.
  • Experiência com versionamento de banco de dados utilizando Flyway.
  • Familiaridade com Lombok e geração de relatórios com JasperReports.
  • Experiência na construção e documentação de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters).
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab.
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub ou similares).
  • Inglês avançado para conversação (imprescindível).
  • Formação Acadêmica completo em cursos correlatos a TI


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logs e tracing).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência no setor automotivo ou em empresas de grande porte.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre qualidade e entrega.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e evolução da arquitetura.
  • Interesse contínuo por aprendizado, inovação e boas práticas de engenharia.

· Data Mesh.

· DDD aplicado a dados.

· Lakehouse Architecture.

· Modelagem dimensional e analítica.

· Metadata e lineage.

· Streaming e Event-Driven Architecture.

· ETL/ELT moderno.

· SQL avançado.

· Snowflake, Databricks ou BigQuery.

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

title: Consultor SAP RE-FX Pleno - SPOT
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP RE-FX Pleno - SPOT em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Funcional SAP RE-FX de nível Pleno para integrar nosso time de AMS (Application Management Services). O perfil ideal combina um sólido conhecimento técnico no módulo de Real Estate com uma mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas e melhoria contínua.

Buscamos alguém que possua autonomia para gerenciar chamados de média e alta complexidade, que compreenda profundamente os processos de gestão imobiliária e financeira e que tenha facilidade em se comunicar com usuários finais para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes dentro do ambiente SAP.

Atribuições principais:

  • Atuar no atendimento de chamados (incidentes e requisições de serviço) seguindo níveis de SLA estabelecidos;
  • Realizar análise de causa raiz e propor melhorias definitivas para o ambiente SAP do cliente;
  • Executar configurações de sistema (customizing/SPRO) no módulo RE-FX;
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais detalhadas para demandas de desenvolvimento (ABAP);
  • Realizar testes integrados e apoiar o usuário em Testes de Aceitação (UAT);
  • Manter a documentação técnica e funcional do projeto atualizada;
  • Garantir a integridade da integração do RE-FX com outros módulos, especialmente FI e CO.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional no módulo SAP RE-FX (Flexible Real Estate Management);
  • Domínio na configuração de Objetos de Arquitetura e de Uso (Business Entities, Buildings, Rental Objects);
  • Sólido conhecimento em Gestão de Contratos (Lease-in e Lease-out) e condições de contrato;
  • Conhecimento profundo nas rotinas de contabilização do RE-FX e integração com SAP FI (Contas a Pagar/Receber e Ativo Imobilizado);
  • Experiência com as normas contábeis IFRS 16 aplicadas ao RE-FX;
  • Vivência anterior em sustentação (AMS) e ferramentas de ITSM (ServiceNow, Jira ou similares);
  • Conhecimento de processos de integração entre RE-FX e PM (Plant Maintenance) ou CO (Controlling).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em SAP S/4HANA;
  • Capacidade de realizar Debug básico de código ABAP;
  • Certificação oficial SAP no módulo RE-FX;
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos satélites (FI-AA, PS ou PM);
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de notas técnicas (SAP Notes).

Localidade da posição: Remoto

Idioma: Português - Nível: Fluente/Nativo

Porque construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.
