  • Trabalhar de forma transversal com marketing, produto, CS e operações para assegurar consistência na proposta de valor;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos, abordagem comercial e eficiência operacional do time.

Buscamos Talentos que tenham:

  • Experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B com ciclos longos e múltiplos decisores;
  • Experiência prévia liderando pessoas;
  • Forte vivência com contas estratégicas e negociações de alto impacto;
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica para gestão de pipeline, forecast e definição de prioridades;
  • Comunicação clara, influência executiva e habilidade de negociação em diferentes níveis organizacionais;
  • Experiência com previsibilidade de vendas e uso disciplinado de CRM (Salesforce é diferencial);
  • Alta capacidade de organização, autonomia e foco consistente em resultados;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais;
  • Perfil comunicador, com escuta ativa e habilidade de desenvolver pessoas;
  • Mentalidade de dono(a), independência e capacidade de tomada de decisão;
  • Energia para atuar em ambiente dinâmico, com iniciativa para propor melhorias e novos caminhos
  • Interesse genuíno em educação e impacto no setor.

Diferencial:

  • Familiaridade com o setor educacional privado (especialmente ensino superior);


O que você vai encontrar na Arco, além de pessoas incríveis:

  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição

  • Vale transporte

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #VemPraArco

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.


Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

É necessário ter habilidade em criar e consumir APIs REST , além de integrar sistemas eficazmente. O candidato deve possuir experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL ou MySQL . Familiaridade com o uso do Git e a prática de metodologias ágeis são cruciais. A capacidade de comunicação clara e eficiente e o trabalho em equipe são necessários para colaborar com times de produto, design e QA. Além disso, o candidato participará da definição de arquitetura e na aplicação de melhorias técnicas, precisando realizar testes, correções de bugs e code reviews.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Conhecimento em testes automatizados, especialmente com ferramentas como RSpec e Minitest , é considerado um diferencial. Experiência com soluções de cloud, como AWS , GCP ou Azure , será altamente valorizada. Familiaridade com Docker e práticas de CI/CD também são desejáveis e podem beneficiar o desenvolvimento contínuo e a implantação de software.


Resumo dos requisitos: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, APIs REST, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Git, RSpec, Minitest, AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, CI/CD .

title: Diretor de Sucesso na Implementação (Pedagogia)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Diretor de Sucesso na Implementação (Pedagogia) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salário: R$10.000,00 a R$30.000,00 por mês.

Localização: 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalho presencial em São Paulo no futuro.

Tipo: Tempo integral

Viagens: Esta função exige viagens para visitar escolas, conduzir treinamentos e apoiar implementações.


Who We Are


A Liza é uma startup de EdTech que usa Inteligência Artificial para ajudar professores a economizar tempo e melhorar a gestão pedagógica. Nossa plataforma ajuda professores a planejar aulas, avaliar atividades, criar exercícios, organizar informações dos alunos e trabalhar de forma mais eficiente em suas rotinas escolares diárias.

Nossa equipe atua entre os Estados Unidos e o Brasil, combinando execução no estilo do Vale do Silício com profundo conhecimento do sistema educacional brasileiro.


Our Leadership


  • Lisa Zhang, Fundadora: fundadora internacional baseada no Vale do Silício
  • Fernando Cofiel, COO: ex-COO da Maple Bear por 9 anos, com experiência em operações escolares, escala e franquias
  • Rogério Luiz, CTO: PhD em Ciência da Computação com foco em Inteligência Artificial


About the Role


Estamos procurando um(a) Diretor(a) de Implementação e Sucesso, educador experiente para liderar a implementação da Liza em escolas e redes de ensino. Esta não é apenas uma função de treinamento de software. Precisamos de alguém que entenda professores, coordenadores, exigências da BNCC, rotinas de sala de aula e os desafios reais da implementação escolar.


Essa pessoa será a ponte entre nossa tecnologia, nosso time de produto e as escolas que utilizam a Liza.


O candidato ideal combina:

  • Apaixonado(a) por educação;
  • Conhecimento pedagógico sólido/ BNCC;
  • Habilidades de implementação e gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência em sucesso do cliente e construção de relacionamento;
  • Conforto com ferramentas digitais e plataformas de EdTech;
  • Bom/boa em explicar tecnologia de forma simples;
  • Confortável treinando professores e coordenadores;
  • Proativo(a) e capaz de resolver problemas com independência;
  • Confortável em um ambiente de startup acelerado;
  • Animado(a) para ajudar a construir uma plataforma educacional com Inteligência Artificial no Brasil;


What You Will Do:


Implementação em escolas

  • Liderar o onboarding de novas escolas e redes de ensino;
  • Criar planos de implementação, cronogramas e agendas de treinamento;
  • Coordenar com líderes escolares, coordenadores, professores e equipes internas;
  • Viajar para escolas quando necessário para treinamentos presenciais e suporte à implementação;


Treinamento de professores

  • Planejar e conduzir workshops remotos e presenciais;
  • Treinar professores sobre como usar a Liza para planejamento de aulas, atividades, avaliações, relatórios e preparação de aulas;
  • Criar exemplos práticos que mostrem como a plataforma economiza tempo e apoia o ensino;
  • Ajudar professores a adotarem a plataforma com clareza, paciência e confiança;


Alinhamento pedagógico

  • Garantir que o uso da plataforma esteja alinhado às competências da BNCC e aos objetivos de aprendizagem;
  • Apoiar coordenadores na conexão da Liza com o planejamento curricular e as rotinas escolares;
  • Ajudar escolas a usarem a Liza de forma prática, pedagógica e fácil de manter;


Sucesso do cliente e Adoção

  • Construir relacionamentos fortes com líderes escolares, coordenadores e professores;
  • Acompanhar adoção, uso, engajamento e feedback das escolas;
  • Identificar riscos cedo, como baixo uso, confusão, resistência ou falta de alinhamento;
  • Criar planos de ação para melhorar a adoção e o sucesso de longo prazo;


Feedbacks

  • Coletar feedback de professores, coordenadores e líderes escolares;
  • Traduzir necessidades das escolas em insights claros para o produto;
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de produto, tecnologia, vendas, sucesso do cliente e liderança;
  • Ajudar a melhorar a plataforma com base nas necessidades reais da sala de aula;


Processos e Relatórios

  • Criar materiais de treinamento, guias de onboarding, checklists e playbooks de implementação;
  • Acompanhar o progresso da implementação em várias escolas;
  • Preparar relatórios sobre adoção, riscos, feedback e próximos passos;
  • Ajudar a construir um modelo de implementação escalável para o crescimento futuro;


Requirement


  • Graduação em Pedagogia, Educação, Licenciatura ou área relacionada;
  • 8+ anos de experiência em educação, coordenação pedagógica, implementação de EdTech, sucesso do cliente, consultoria educacional ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência prévia trabalhando diretamente com escolas como professor(a), coordenador(a), consultor(a) ou líder de implementação;
  • Forte conhecimento da BNCC e das exigências curriculares brasileiras;
  • Experiência com educação infantil e/ou ensino fundamental é um grande diferencial;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e treinamento;
  • Fortes habilidades de gestão de projetos e organização;
  • Conforto para gerenciar múltiplas implementações escolares ao mesmo tempo;
  • Conforto no uso de ferramentas digitais, plataformas de software, dashboards e produtos de EdTech;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar remotamente com disciplina e independência;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar para escolas quando necessário;
  • Português fluente obrigatório;


Preferred qualifications


  • Proficiência em inglês será um grande diferencial;
  • Pós-graduação em Design Instrucional, Tecnologia Educacional, Gestão Pedagógica ou Liderança Escolar;
  • Experiência prévia em EdTech, SaaS, Sucesso do Cliente, Implementação ou Consultoria Educacional;
  • Experiência implementando ferramentas digitais em escolas ou redes de ensino;
  • Experiência liderando programas de formação de professores ou workshops de desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Experiência trabalhando com redes de escolas privadas, sistemas públicos de ensino ou secretarias municipais de educação;
  • Experiência criando materiais de treinamento, guias de onboarding ou playbooks de implementação;

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.


This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.


You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para desenvolvedor sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

olá, dev sênior | Node.js & React!


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada de comércio B2B que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar. uma empresa jovem com um sonho grande: transformar o atacado da moda brasileira.


a teceo tem uma plataforma com muito sendo construído: catálogo, pedido, integrações com ERPs, políticas comerciais, sell-out, webhooks, gateway de pagamento. o volume de produto é alto e a complexidade técnica também. aqui dev precisa entender o negócio!


esse cargo é pra quem tem maturidade pra tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia, questionar arquitetura quando faz sentido, e traduzir um desafio de negócio em solução sem precisar de muita mão na mão. você vai trabalhar num time fullstack com um fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA, onde ferramentas como claude code, open code e agentes de code review fazem parte do dia a dia, e esperamos que você saiba tirar proveito disso.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se desafiar e sair da zona de conforto, ajudando a construir uma plataforma que está mudando como o atacado da moda funciona no Brasil.


o que você vai fazer

  • projetar e desenvolver novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade
  • criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, funcionais e de integração)
  • discutir arquitetura, tecnologias e caminhos técnicos com o time
  • traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas simples e eficientes
  • contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • participar das cerimônias ágeis
  • apoiar o time de suporte em dúvidas técnicas quando necessário


fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA

na teceo, IA não é palavra da moda — é ferramenta de trabalho:

  • geração de documentações de negócio e especificações técnicas com IA
  • uso de claude code, open code e outras ferramentas no processo de codificação
  • code review e refinamento via agentes (ex: coderabbit)
  • correção de bugs com apoio de agentes


o que procuramos em você

  • sólido conhecimento em React e Node.js, com experiência em NestJS
  • experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e arquitetura REST
  • vivência com microsserviços e integrações entre sistemas
  • experiência com testes automatizados
  • desejável: CI/CD e configuração de Docker
  • boa comunicação verbal e escrita — você vai precisar se posicionar tecnicamente
  • ao menos 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento fullstack


o que oferecemos

  • remuneração de R$ 9,5k a R$ 16k
  • contratação PJ
  • programa de partnership
  • bonificação semestral
  • cartão Swile e TotalPass
  • home-office
  • horários flexíveis
  • bootcamp teceo — imersão presencial anual com o time
  • fio-da-meada — rumos e números do negócio numa reunião trimestral
  • eventos: happy hours, learning days, torneios e por aí vai

title: Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.


Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

  • Own and implement backend services, APIs, and integrations aligned with approved Feature Design Documents
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following platform standards
  • Proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt within scope
  • Act as the primary gatekeeper for backend code quality through thorough PR reviews
  • Review code for correctness, readability, performance, resource usage, and test coverage
  • Block merges that do not meet quality standards and provide actionable feedback
  • Ensure all implementations align with architectural guidelines and platform standards

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst - 57510 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Tech Lead - Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead - Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Review Attorney em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.com 

At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth.


We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting.


About the Role 

This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well.


We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business.
  • Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms.
  • Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. 
  • Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. 
  • Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early.
  • Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.


What You Bring

Experience & Qualifications

  • Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution
  • Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus)
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements.
  • Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. 
  • Excellent English skills, both written and spoken. 


Mindset & Strengths

  • Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations.
  • Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail.
  • Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership.
  • Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care.
  • A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.


Why Join Us 

Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.


IMPORTANT

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.


Compensation: $40-60/hour depending on experience

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied Scientist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits; candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. The Senior Applied Scientist will own the development and deployment of machine learning solutions while influencing the technical direction of the team.

This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, along with a strong focus on building robust production-ready systems and mentoring team members.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key system components and solutions to ensure business needs are met.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor team members and help establish domain expertise across the team.
  • Contribute to the company’s intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or 8+ years of equivalent industry experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning algorithms and techniques, including CNNs, transformers, GANs, optimizers, and regularization, as well as experiment design and best practices such as A/B testing, training and serving pipelines, and feature engineering.
  • Extensive experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and Machine Learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experiment automation frameworks such as Ray Tune, Weights & Biases (W&B), and Kubeflow.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python.


Preferred Requirements

  • PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Background applying Machine Learning techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

DESENVOLVEDOR BACK-END JAVA SENIOR (COM INGLÊS AVANÇADO)

Fará parte de um time de tecnologia altamente colaborativo, atuando em projetos estratégicos que envolvem soluções digitais, integrações complexas e construção de plataformas escaláveis na nuvem.

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.
  • Aplicar princípios de arquitetura moderna, com foco em Arquitetura Hexagonal e desacoplamento entre camadas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, POs e demais desenvolvedores na definição de soluções técnicas aderentes ao negócio.

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com desenvolvimento backend em Java.
  • Domínio do ecossistema Spring: Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Spring Cloud.
  • Experiência com Hibernate e ferramentas de build como Maven.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes com JUnit e Mockito.
  • Experiência com versionamento de banco de dados utilizando Flyway.

  • Experiência na construção e documentação de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters).
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab.
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logs e tracing).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Perfil esperado

  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre qualidade e entrega.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e evolução da arquitetura.
  • Interesse contínuo por aprendizado, inovação e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de back end em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in cruises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and implement backend services, APIs, and integrations aligned with approved Feature Design Documents
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following platform standards
  • Proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt within scope
  • Act as the primary gatekeeper for backend code quality through thorough PR reviews
  • Review code for correctness, readability, performance, resource usage, and test coverage
  • Block merges that do not meet quality standards and provide actionable feedback
  • Ensure all implementations align with architectural guidelines and platform standards
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, targeting 80%+ code coverage
  • Contribute to and improve overall test strategies and practices
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, ensuring root cause resolution
  • Participate in root cause analysis and postmortems
  • Raise technical risks and architectural concerns proactively
  • Collaborate with Tech Lead to ensure alignment on implementation and design direction
  • Partner with mobile engineers on API design and integration contracts
  • Support QA teams with testability improvements and defect resolution
  • Mentor mid-level developers through code reviews and pairing sessions


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong experience with .NET / C# in production environments
  • Solid experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture
  • Hands-on experience with trunk-based development and continuous integration
  • Strong commitment to code quality and 80%+ test coverage
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest
  • Experience with mocking frameworks (NSubstitute preferred, Moq, FakeItEasy)
  • Familiarity with test data generation tools like AutoFixture or Bogus
  • Experience with container-based development and TestContainers
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) with governance awareness
  • Advanced English


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

  • • International team environment

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
description:

Responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior para integrar o time de uma empresa de que presta serviço de BPO Financeiro, consultoria e serviços de CFO Service nos EUA, atuando como peça-chave na gestão financeira estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de diferentes portes, segmentos e níveis de maturidade.
